Executive summary: I'm tired of living vicariously.

I recently started playing Guild Wars 2, the most popular MMORPG. I discovered the same thing I found when playing TERA, or Skyrim. Most games don't do anything for me anymore, the pointless of it all bothers me. And out of three games I mentioned Skyrim is the best. Because they are all effectively single player. MMO's are just like the real world, you end up alone in a crowd.

Of course I try to play to take my mind off my frustrations. To kill time. But, that hasn't really worked. But whenever I try to to something productive IRL, my living situation and the connected emotions get in my way. Yes I hope to move soon, but still ANGST.

I also got it into my head to try and learn Nihongo from VN's, problem most are fundamentally romance based. This adds to the ANGST, because I'm ForeverAlone(TM) again because of my living situation. The same applies to any romance story. Good or bad outcome, all I feel is emptiness or ANGST.
